confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated Santiago estimates from cost-of-living sites and travel blogs, some of which are Brazilian or convert from EUR. Their CLP figures were converted at roughly 930 CLP per USD, a rate inferred from the USD values quoted in the sources. The cocktail anchor is derived at about 2x the draft beer anchor because no reliable 2026 cocktail price was found. The wine glass anchor is inferred from retail bottle prices plus a restaurant markup, because no restaurant wine-by-the-glass price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context. No accommodation searches or live listings were checked. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could find, dated 2026-03-20 and taken from a search snippet of the RBA exchange rates page, not a direct page read. It is about seven months older than the generation date, and I could not locate a newer RBA observation within the search budget.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Santiago-specific aggregated estimates, including the menu del dia range (roughly CLP 7,000 to 16,000), a cappuccino near CLP 3,200, and a pub draft beer near CLP 4,000. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for Santiago.
